Military Commander Reviews Anti-Terror Operations in Poonch

The General Officer Commanding (GOC) of the White Knight Corps visited operational locations in Poonch to review ongoing anti-terror operations. The visit occurred amidst these operations in the region. Separately, Jammu and Kashmir Police reviewed security measures for minorities and anti-terror operations in Kulgam.
